research_question: Can content-disjoint, source-diverse authentic training images reduce external real-image false positives while retaining CIFAKE transformation robustness and unseen-FLUX recall?

research_positioning.reason: E4 was motivated by the frozen Section 4 finding that E3 falsely flagged 646 of 1000 SID-Set real images.

cifake.role: Existing balanced real and Stable-Diffusion-based AI supervision.

sid_set_real.role: Additional authentic-domain supervision only; no SID-Set synthetic or tampered images are permitted in E4 development.
sid_set_real.underlying_real_source: Open Images V7 according to the SID-Set dataset card
sid_set_real.underlying_real_license: CC-BY-2.0 images with per-image attribution requirements

sid_real_sampling.page_ordering: Sort page indices by SHA-256 of '<seed>:page:<page_index>'.
sid_real_sampling.candidate_ranking: Sort eligible real rows by SHA-256 of '<seed>:row:<row_idx>:<img_id>'; allocate the first 3000 accepted unique images to train and the next 1000 to validation.
sid_real_sampling.content_deduplication: Reject byte-identical content across E4 train, E4 validation, and the frozen Section 4B audit.
sid_real_sampling.identity_deduplication: Reject any img_id already present in the frozen Section 4B audit.
sid_real_sampling.source_split_isolation: E4 development uses SID-Set train only; the existing audit uses SID-Set validation only.

frozen_section4_audit.future_E4_use: Post-hoc adapted-domain audit only; not a fresh unbiased held-out test because its E3 result motivated E4.

organiser_validation_subset.description: WildFake subset: COCO val2017 real and DALL-E Advanced AIGC

initialization.reason: Continue from the preselected robust head while changing only the authentic-domain supervision.

training.pair_definition: Each sampled clean embedding is paired with one registered transformed embedding of the identical path and label.

validation_and_threshold_selection.data: CIFAKE validation plus content-disjoint SID-Set-train real validation; no test or audit data.
validation_and_threshold_selection.sid_real_constraint_scope: Maximum empirical false-positive rate across clean and all six representative transformed SID real validation views.
validation_and_threshold_selection.epoch_and_threshold_objective: Among thresholds satisfying the SID real FPR constraint, maximize unweighted mean CIFAKE balanced accuracy across clean and all six representative transformed validation conditions.
validation_and_threshold_selection.infeasible_fallback: If no threshold in the frozen grid satisfies the constraint, select the threshold with minimum worst SID real FPR, then maximum CIFAKE mean balanced accuracy.
validation_and_threshold_selection.tie_break_3: Lower threshold to favor AI recall.
validation_and_threshold_selection.uncertainty_reporting: Report binomial Wilson intervals for validation false-positive rates; the 5% target is empirical, not a population guarantee.

evaluation.cifake_test: Post-hoc comparison because Section 4 CIFAKE test results were already inspected before E4 design.
evaluation.sid_set_validation_audit: Post-hoc adapted-domain audit; row- and content-disjoint from E4 development but not a fresh design-independent test.
